Bangalore has filed this chargesheet against the accused No.1 to 4 for the offences punishable U/s.420, 380, 506 r/w/s 34 of IPC.
 2.The criminal law has been set into motion based on the first information statement of K.Narayanappa.

The gist of the prosecution case is that on 01-07-2012 at 10.00 a.m. the accused No.1 to 4 with common intention committed theft of documents viz., original documents related to house property, documents related to Education and job, cheques belongs to CW-1 from his house situated at House No.367, 6th A Cross, Banashankari 3rd Stage.

It is further alleged that accused persons have dishonestly and fraudulently created the documents and gave false information to the Sub-Registrar's office as if those documents are genuine one  3  C.C.No.8699/2015 and thus cheated CW-1.
Further the accused persons with common intention to deceive the CW 1 and 2 cheated them and threatened them with dire consequences.
Based on the said first information, a case in Crime No.233/2013 came to be registered against the Accused for the offences punishable U/s.420, 380, 506 r/w/s 34 of IPC.
3. Accused No.1 to 4 were in J.C..

Accordingly I answer point No.1 in the Negative.
15. POINT No.2:-

In the result, I proceed to pass the following:-

In exercise of power conferred U/s.248(1) of Cr.P.C., Accused No.1,3 and 4 are acquitted of the offences punishable U/s.420, 380, 506 r/w/s 34 of IPC.
The bail bond and surety bonds executed by the accused No.1,3 and 4 shall remain in force for 6 months.
